name: CopyPackageVersionsResult
description: CopyPackageVersionsResult schema from Amazon CodeArtifact API

allOf.description: A list of the package versions that were successfully copied to your repository.

A map of package versions that failed to copy and their error codes. The possible error codes are in the PackageVersionError data type. They are:

  • ALREADY_EXISTS

  • MISMATCHED_REVISION

  • MISMATCHED_STATUS

  • NOT_ALLOWED

  • NOT_FOUND

  • SKIPPED
